Selection rule

Spend intelligence where uncertainty lives.

Routine implementation should use the least costly lane that has demonstrated it can pass the relevant gates. A more capable model is useful when the work contains a named architectural, product, or failure-mode uncertainty.

The review packet should include the accepted intent, exact revision, relevant diff or artifact, and the question to adjudicate. This keeps the expensive seat focused and makes its advice traceable.
